summary: Verified all 3 IAP production-e2e fixes in /app/backend/routes/iap.py end-to-end via 8-test pytest suite (100% pass, ~8s). (Fix 1) receipt email subject is exactly 'Subscription Confirmed — Receipt Enclosed' — mojibake 'Subscription സ്ഥിരീകര — Receipt Enclosed' is fully absent from backend logs. (Fix 2) IAPSimulationRequest accepts optional name + address_line: 'George Latoria' persists on users.name (create + update paths), 'QUEENS WAY' persists on users.billing_address_line AND lands in payment_transactions.jurisdiction.address_line via _apply_iap_subscription. (Fix 3) simulate_failure_case default is False — omitting the field and setting it false both produce failure_case=null and NO _send_iap_failure_notification is invoked. Live evidence: full pipeline runs against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL against fresh iap.e2e.iter883.<random>@example.com emails, response returns success:true with all 4 checks true (fee_accuracy, notification_latency_under_2s, subscription_active, api_integrity), notification latency ~400-700ms, pricing_breakdown exactly base=15.99 + platform_fee=5.01 + taxes=0.72 = final_total=21.72 for premium/monthly with OK jurisdiction. DB assertions: user.name='George Latoria', subscription_plan='premium', subscription_status='active', billing_address_line='QUEENS WAY'; payment_transactions.jurisdiction={country:US,state:OK,postal_code:73521-1001,city:Altus,address_line:QUEENS WAY}, status='completed', notification_sent=true; in-app notification title='Payment Successful — Premium Plan Activated' + message contains IAP-<ticket> + total 21.72. Backend logs verified: '[Resend] Email sent ... subject=Subscription Confirmed — Receipt Enclosed', 'Branded receipt email sent to iap.e2e.iter883.*', '[Resend] Email sent to admin@realaicoach.app: subject=[Admin] Payment Confirmed via Google Play — RCT-...', and 'Admin payment receipt email sent: admin@realaicoach.app (RCT-...)' — all four expected log lines fire per e2e call. Regression: omitting name/address_line still works (pricing intact); GET /api/iap/admin/compliance-bundles returns 200 list; GET /api/iap/admin/compliance-bundles/{tx_id}/receipt.pdf returns 200 with application/pdf content-type and %PDF magic bytes.
critical_code_review_comments: iap.py is ~2881 lines — well over the 700-line threshold; recommend splitting into routes/iap/ package (checkout, subscriptions, admin_simulation, compliance) in a follow-up refactor.

In simulate_iap_production_e2e (line ~1974) the create path only sets billing_address_line when body.address_line is truthy, but does NOT strip whitespace before checking `if body.address_line:` — a whitespace-only string would produce an empty billing_address_line. The update path (line ~1982) does check .strip() correctly. Cosmetic — recommend aligning both paths to use `if body.address_line and body.address_line.strip():`.

custom_receipt_subject is passed only from simulate_iap_production_e2e; real production Apple/Google webhook paths (~lines 2214, 2248, 2314, 2433) still rely on the default receipt subject inside _apply_iap_subscription / _send_payment_email. If those defaults ever regress to the mojibake string, the guard on simulate would not catch it. Recommend a unit assert on the default subject constant as a safety net.

The 30-min duplicate-notification suppression (per user+provider+plan+period) means re-running the simulation for the SAME test email produces success:true but no new notification, and notification_latency_under_2s may fail — the test uses a fresh uuid email per invocation which is the right pattern. Documenting this here so future testing agents keep it.

Emails to @example.com will attempt real Resend sends and Resend will accept them (logged as delivered ids) — this is expected/desired for log-signal verification but produces Resend delivery bounces asynchronously. No email is sent to kadjimonn@gmail.com anywhere in this run.
test_credentials: admin@realaicoach.app / NewAdminPass2026! (cookie-based /api/auth/login; is_admin=true confirmed; X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header required for POST to pass CSRF middleware)
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 4-6 fresh users prefixed 'iap.e2e.iter883.<random>@example.com' plus corresponding payment_transactions, notifications, and iap_compliance_bundles rows. These are TEST_ analogs (namespaced by prefix) and were intentionally left in-place for main agent to inspect. Total volume per run is small (<10 users). No production or real-user data was modified. kadjimonn@gmail.com was NOT re-emailed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_iap_production_e2e_iter883.py (8 tests, ~8s runtime). Fixture pattern: cookie-session admin login sending X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest for CSRF; response is a flat user dict (is_admin at top level, NOT nested under 'user'). Motor client is at `from routes.db import db` (NOT `from database import ...`). Use uuid-scoped test emails per test to bypass the 30-min duplicate-notification suppression. Log signal verification greps 600KB tail of backend.err.log + backend.out.log for the four required strings; if you need to re-test after a code change, run the test twice — first run seeds the log window, second run makes the assertions robust. Pricing regression targets: premium/monthly OK => 15.99 + 5.01 + 0.72 = 21.72; if this breaks, check /app/backend/shared/pricing_policy.py::get_plan_amount and _apply_iap_subscription's tax computation.
rca of the issue: Original defects (identified in prior audit): (1) 'Subscription സ്ഥിരീകര — Receipt Enclosed' — a mojibake corruption of the intended 'Subscription Confirmed — Receipt Enclosed' caused by a copy-paste from a non-UTF8 source or a locale-transliterated string; would leak Malayalam characters into every user's receipt email subject. Fix: hard-coded custom_receipt_subject='Subscription Confirmed — Receipt Enclosed' passed into _apply_iap_subscription at line ~2023. (2) name + address_line missing from the payment simulation payload model, so admin operator could not attach human identity to the tx or receipt; user record and receipt/tx jurisdiction lacked the billing address. Fix: added optional name + address_line to IAPSimulationRequest (line ~771-772); create path (line ~1974) sets user_doc.billing_address_line; update path (line ~1982) sets profile_updates.billing_address_line and .name; parsed['address_line'] (line ~2005) flows via _apply_iap_subscription (line ~1385-1386) into jurisdiction which is persisted on payment_transactions and stamped on the receipt PDF. (3) simulate_failure_case defaulted to True (line ~780) meaning EVERY successful simulation ALSO fired _send_iap_failure_notification producing a spurious 'payment failed' email to the same user seconds after the receipt email — an operator-triggered anti-pattern. Fix: default changed to False; test verifies failure_case=null when field is omitted OR explicitly set to false, and no failure notification is logged. All three fixes verified live against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with response body + DB rows + Resend log signals, all consistent.
